title: How Much Fiber in an Artichoke? 6.9g per Artichoke
description: Artichoke: about 6.9 g of fiber per 1 medium globe artichoke, raw (25% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in an artichoke?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists artichokes, (globe or french), raw at 5.4 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 medium globe artichoke, raw (edible part); 128 g) therefore has about 6.9 g of fiber and 60 calories. That is 25% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 28% of a 25 g day and 18% of a 38 g day.
A whole globe artichoke is one of the highest-fiber vegetables per serving. Part of its fiber is inulin, a soluble fiber that feeds gut bacteria.

sections.heading: Whole artichokes vs canned hearts
paragraphs: Eating a whole steamed artichoke leaf by leaf takes time, and you only eat the tender base of each leaf plus the heart. USDA’s figures are for the edible portion.
Canned or jarred hearts in oil or brine are convenient for salads and pasta. Marinated hearts carry added oil; the fiber per heart is similar.

sections.heading: How artichoke compares with other vegetables
paragraphs: Of the 10 vegetables on this site, artichoke ranks #1 for fiber per typical serving and #1 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 11.5 g of fiber per 100 calories, a high ratio: you get a lot of fiber for the calories.

Close neighbors by serving: [butternut squash](/fiber-in-butternut-squash) at 6.6 g (1 cup cubes, baked); [broccoli](/fiber-in-broccoli) at 5.1 g (1 cup chopped, cooked); [kale](/fiber-in-kale) at 4.7 g (1 cup, cooked). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), artichoke is #4 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding artichoke to your day
paragraphs: Add a cup of drained artichoke hearts to pasta, pizza, or a white bean salad.

Example: 1 artichoke, 1/2 cup navy beans, 1 slice whole wheat bread. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 18.4 g of fiber, with 6.9 g from the artichoke. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of artichoke?
faqs.a: 5.4 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Artichokes, (globe or french), raw). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in artichoke (1 medium artichoke, cooked)?
faqs.a: About 6.8 g (Artichokes, (globe or french), cooked, boiled, drained, without salt), for 120 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.
